name: UL probe experiment 5 min motor hold
description: DIAGNOSTIC (2026-10-27): holds the motor running for 4 min so CHAN1/UL can be probed by hand at different ranges/couplings while the shaft turns (Kim's request). interval_sec 300 so the run takes ONE sweep at start and then leaves the scope free, with samples_per_step 75 so the runner still ticks every 4 s (tick = interval/samples_per_step; a first attempt with 400/3 ticked every 133 s and never started the motor). 20 s rest, 240 s at speed, 40 s rest.
